scope: Independent visual review of walk-v2 only, including explicit correction of an earlier reviewer claim about south-facing stride.

definite_failures.finding: The third NE pose turns to a front/right-facing view with gold front vest/face exposure instead of the required rear-right coat/head view. This reverses the view during one gait cycle.
definite_failures.comparison: NE phase0/1 are rear-right; NE phase2 is front/right.

definite_failures.finding: The held card switches to the opposite arm. The rear-view guide and phase0/1 raise the viewer-left card arm, while phase2 raises the viewer-right arm and moves the free glove to the other hip.
definite_failures.claim_limit: A handedness/occlusion violation is directly visible. This report does not claim the PNG was literally pixel-mirrored.

S.evidence: S phase0 lifts the viewer-right knee while viewer-left leg supports. S phase2 lifts viewer-left knee while viewer-right leg supports. Phase1 passes narrowly beneath the hips.
S.correction: The earlier blanket claim that E/S/W all repeat the same leading leg is unsupported for S and must not be reused as a verified failure fact.

E_W.finding: Opposite anatomical near/far-leg alternation is not sufficiently established.
E_W.evidence: Phase0/2 project similar forward-knee silhouettes; without reliable near/far thigh occlusion, a shared screen-space leading-foot position alone does not prove the same anatomical leg.
E_W.classification: Unproven alternation, not a definitive same-leg identity claim.

hold_reason: The definite NE view reversal and NW/N card-hand switches independently prevent a valid stable8-direction walk, regardless of the positively observed S stride.
reference_guide_and_idle_status: Previously approved8-view guide and16idle poses remain partial source work. No finished five-role actor or104pose approval is claimed.
